title: Character consistency and an earned behavioral break

finding.title: Devin reverses his explicit refusal to use a gun
finding.summary: Devin defines refusing gun violence as a core boundary, then shoots a guard who is only reaching for an alarm.
finding.question: Is Devin's reversal of his stated boundary intentional here?
finding.conflicting_fact_a: Devin says he will never point a gun at anyone.
finding.conflicting_fact_b: Devin draws a pistol and shoots an unarmed guard.
finding.inference_explanation: No current event challenges or changes Devin's stated boundary.

evidence.quote: I will never point a gun at anyone. That is the line I do not cross.
Devin draws a pistol and shoots the unarmed guard as he reaches for the alarm.
